strings.instalock_risk_body: Instalock locks your agent automatically after a random delay, similar to timing you could do by hand. Tools that lock instantly (under 1 second) are considered cheat-like and can get you banned; RankYoinker's randomized 11-12 second delay stays within normal human reaction times and isn't an unfair advantage. Still, any automation carries some residual risk with Riot, use it at your own responsibility.
